Recorded trails nearest the stops: Žabljak - Šarban (via Bobotov kuk) (0.3 km from Bobotov Kuk), Šarban - Škrka - Nedajno (0.2 km from Durmitor), Crno jezero - Škrčka jezera (0.7 km from Durmitor National Park) and Ivan Do - Gornja Ališnica (0.5 km from Black Lake), and 4 more. Elevation runs from 675 m at Lake Piva to 2,523 m at Durmitor. Hard: more than 22 km or 800 m of ascent in a day, or ground above 3,000 m. The longest day is 20 km, with up to 1182 m of ascent. Distances are straight lines between stops, not trail distance; 50.8 km in total.
